reveal.mechanism: IntersectionObserver adds .is-visible; CSS animates opacity+translateY with fill:forwards. .is-settled is added on animationend to drop the transform.

rules: NEVER put .reveal on an element inside a horizontally-scrolling rail. Off-viewport items never intersect and stay at opacity:0 permanently. Put it on the rail container.
NEVER rely on an inline transform on a .reveal element. The animation uses fill:forwards and silently overrides it — put rotation/offset on a wrapper.
A finished animation keeps the element on its own compositor layer, which can inflate the document. .is-settled returns it to normal paint.
